common.tagline: See where your money is leaking — in taka, with proof.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
errors.slugTaken: That web address is already taken. Try another.
errors.slugInvalid: Use 3–40 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.
errors.notAllowed: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
errors.inviteWrongEmail: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with the invited email.
errors.inviteAlreadyMember: You already have this role in the organization.
errors.notFound: We could not find that page.
errors.priceBasisLocked: The price basis cannot change after the first order.
errors.nameTaken: That name is already used here.
errors.recipeInvalid: Check the recipe: each line needs an ingredient, a quantity above zero and a yield of 1–100%.
errors.photoInvalid: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo under 5 MB.
errors.menuRequired: Paste the menu or add a photo of it.
errors.aiNotConfigured: AI drafting is not switched on yet.
errors.aiCapExceeded: Today's AI allowance for this restaurant is used up. Try again tomorrow.
errors.aiFailed: The AI draft did not work this time. Try again, or write the recipe by hand.
errors.draftNeedsItem: Choose which menu item this recipe is for, and save, before approving.
errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a Bangladeshi mobile number, e.g. 01712345678.
errors.purchaseLinesInvalid: Check the lines: each needs an ingredient, a quantity in a unit that fits it, and what was paid.
errors.purchaseInputRequired: Add a photo of the chit, or type or say what was bought.
errors.quantityInvalid: That quantity does not fit — use numbers, and a unit that suits the ingredient.
errors.countEmpty: Count at least one ingredient before submitting.
errors.wasteInvalid: Pick what was wasted, how much, and why.
errors.transferInvalid: Pick another branch and at least one ingredient to send.
errors.referenceCsvInvalid: No usable rows. Use: ingredient, taka, per (kg / litre / piece / dozen), date (YYYY-MM-DD), source.

auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in to your restaurant dashboard.
auth.signUpSubtitle: Start with your email. You will set up your restaurant next.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.inviteHint: Use the email address this invitation was sent to.
auth.inviteBody: Accept the invitation to join this restaurant's workspace. You must be signed in with the invited email address.

landing.headline: See where your money is leaking.
landing.featureOfflineBody: The till keeps taking orders through power cuts and dropped internet.
landing.featureLeaksBody: Voids, discounts and commission drag, ranked by BDT impact — with proof.
landing.featureLanguageBody: Every screen works in Bangla and English, switchable any time.

onboarding.title: Set up your restaurant
onboarding.subtitle: You can change everything later. Add each branch you run.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's what needs your attention.
dashboard.emptyBody: Sales, profit and leak findings will appear here once orders start flowing in. Next: set up your menu and start taking orders.
dashboard.actionPosBody: Take orders, send to kitchen, take payment.
dashboard.actionKdsBody: See tickets oldest-first, mark them ready.
dashboard.actionStaffBody: Add staff, set PINs, manage devices.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Invite managers and staff, and choose which branches they can see.
team.inviteReady: Invitation created. Share this link with them — it works once and expires in 7 days.
team.roleNeedsBranch: Choose at least one branch for this role.
team.confirmRemove: Remove this member? They lose access immediately.

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: The people who sign in with a PIN at the till and kitchen screen.
staff.name: Name
staff.managerLimit: Only the owner can add a manager or reset their PIN.
staff.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits. You can set this later from the list below.
staff.emptyBody: Add your first cashier or kitchen staff member.
staff.devicesBody: Tablets and screens paired to this branch.

branch.title: Branch setup
branch.subtitle: Tables, kitchen stations, and this branch's own prices.
branch.menuBody: 86 an item here, or give it a price that differs from the printed menu.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How your prices, taxes and business day work.
settings.priceInclusive: Include VAT (customer pays the menu price)
settings.priceExclusive: Exclude VAT (VAT is added at the till)
settings.priceBasisHelp: Locked after your first order, so your history stays comparable.
settings.regulatoryNote: Tax rules change. Enter the rates your accountant confirms — Xedine never assumes them.
settings.cutoffHelp: Late-night orders before this time belong to the previous business day.
settings.receiptSubtitle: Printed on receipts and KOTs. Mushak 6.3 fields — TODO(verify) with your accountant.
settings.binHelp: Business Identification Number — TODO(verify) with your accountant.
settings.whatsappBody: A morning brief at 9:00, an evening close at 23:00 and a weekly review, and you can ask questions by message. Nothing is sent until you tick the box.
settings.whatsappConsent: Yes, send my briefs and answers to this number on WhatsApp.

surfaces.qrBody: Optional QR table ordering arrives after Pilot gate A.
surfaces.adminBody: Platform administrators have no access to restaurant data by default.

pos.pairSubtitle: Register this tablet to a branch. You only need to do this once.
pos.pinLocked: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
pos.shiftClosedBanner: No shift is open on this device.
pos.actionRefused: The server refused that. Refresh the order and try again.
pos.approvalRejected: The manager approval was missing, expired or already used. Ask again.
pos.discardWarning: Discarding removes this from the queue for good. Check with a manager first.
pos.discrepancyFlagged: The drawer does not match. This difference is recorded for the owner.
pos.firstLoadNeedsInternet: This till has never loaded its menu. Connect to the internet once to start.
pos.noManagers: No manager has a PIN at this branch yet. The owner can add one under Staff.
pos.notAManager: Only a manager or the owner can approve this.
pos.notSentYet: Not sent to the kitchen yet
pos.offlineBanner: Offline. Orders and payments are saved on this tablet and sync automatically.
pos.offlineCached: Offline, using the menu saved on this tablet. Orders and payments sync automatically.
pos.orderRefused: The server refused this order. Check the items and try again.
pos.ordersOffline: Offline: only sales from this tablet that are waiting to sync are shown.
pos.paymentRefused: The server refused this payment. Check the amount and try again.
pos.provisionalNote: Provisional receipt number. The final invoice number is assigned when this sale syncs.
pos.someActionsNeedInternet: Voids, discounts, refunds and new rounds need the internet.
pos.syncBeforeClose: Wait until everything has synced before closing the shift.
pos.syncBody: Sales taken offline are sent to the server in order when the internet returns. Nothing is lost if the tablet restarts.
pos.tenderOverBalance: Only cash can be more than the amount due.

kds.wasteFailed: Could not log it. Check the connection and try again.

menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: Categories and items. Prices are the printed menu price.
menu.addOnGroupsBody: Groups of add-ons (like Spice level or Extras) that items can offer at the till.

health.subtitle: Business day {date}. Figures update as orders are completed.
health.paceNone: Not enough past weeks to compare yet.
health.paceOf: {pct} of a typical day by this time
health.breakevenRemaining: {amount} more sales to break even today
health.assumedCogs: Estimate: food cost assumed at {pct} of sales until recipes are set up.
health.habitsBody: The few entries that make food-cost numbers true. What is still missing today:
health.mixedCogs: Food cost from recipes where they exist; {pct} assumed for dishes without one.

sales.title: Sales explorer
sales.subtitle: What sold, how many and when — by branch, channel and time of day.

leaks.title: Where am I losing money?
leaks.subtitle: Found from your till data alone, ranked by taka and confidence. Every one shows its evidence.
leaks.emptyBody: Checks run every night after the day closes. You can also scan now.

impactLabel.usage_unexplained: Worth, beyond what other branches lose

evidence.staffVsPeers: {count} in {orders} orders ({value}); colleagues' rate would predict {expected}.
evidence.peers: Colleagues at this branch: {count} in {orders} orders ({value}).
evidence.cashShare: {share} of their {orders} orders were cash; {expected} expected for the same times of day.
evidence.commission: {orders} orders, {net} in sales; commission {pct} = {commission}. All platform costs: {share} of its sales.
evidence.marginBelowTarget: {qty} sold for {net}; recipe cost {cost}: food cost {pct} against a {target} target.
evidence.negativeMargin: {qty} sold for {net}; recipe cost {cost} plus commission {commission} is more than the sales.
evidence.usage: Recipes say {theoretical}; the kitchen actually used {actual}, and {waste} was logged as waste. {unexplained} is unexplained ({rate}) — other branches lose {baseline}.
evidence.voidedDishes: {qty} went into dishes cooked and then voided after the kitchen ticket.
evidence.posExceptions: {count, plural, one {# POS exception} other {# POS exceptions}} found at this branch in the same period — check them together.
evidence.transferSuspected: This branch used {over} more than it should, while {toBranch} used {under} less ({match}% match) — goods probably moved without a transfer.
evidence.priceDrift: Paid above both the usual price and the market on {days} day(s): {overpay} over, {paid} spent.
evidence.transferUnconfirmed: Sent by {from} on {date}; nobody here has confirmed receiving it.
evidence.transferDisputed: Sent by {from} on {date}; less arrived than was sent.

action.review_voids: Go through these voids with the cashier and the kitchen.
action.require_manager_on_cash_voids: Make every void after the ticket need a manager's PIN (already on) and check who approved these.
action.talk_to_staff: Talk to the staff member before drawing conclusions.
action.review_discounts: Check who these discounts went to.
action.require_reason_codes: Require a reason on every discount.
action.set_discount_limit: Make large discounts need a manager's approval.
action.review_refunds: Check each refund against its original order.
action.check_digital_payments_offered: Check that bKash, Nagad and card are offered at this till.
action.spot_count_drawer: Do a surprise cash count during this person's shift.
action.recount_with_manager: Count the drawer with a manager at every close for two weeks.
action.blind_cash_count: Ask for the cash count before showing the expected amount.
action.raise_platform_prices: Price items higher on the platform to cover commission.
action.push_own_delivery: Move regulars to your own delivery.
action.review_combo_margins: Check which combos still make money after commission.
action.raise_price: Raise the price, or check the price & portion simulator first.
action.trim_portion: Check the portion against the recipe in the kitchen.
action.renegotiate_supplier: Ask suppliers for a better price on the main ingredient.
action.remove_from_platform: Take the item off this platform, or sell it there as a smaller version.
action.check_portions: Watch portions of the dishes named, and weigh a few
action.log_all_waste: Make sure every bit of waste is logged
action.lock_the_store: Keep the store locked; one person holds the key
action.recount: Recount this ingredient to rule out a counting error
action.count_both_branches: Count this ingredient at both branches today
action.check_store_keys: Check who has access to the store at both branches
action.compare_suppliers: Compare with other suppliers and branches
action.ask_for_receipts: Ask for a written receipt for every purchase
action.set_price_limits: Agree price limits with the purchaser
action.confirm_receipt: Confirm what arrived on the Stock page
action.check_transport: Check how goods are carried between branches

leaks.dismissReason: Why is this not a problem?
leaks.noEvents: No rows found for this period.
leaks.askPrompt: Explain finding {id} in simple words, and tell me what to do.
leaks.actOnIt: What will you do about it?
leaks.usageRates: Unexplained: {rate} of what recipes say. Normal here: {baseline}. Beyond normal: {excess}.
leaks.suspectsTitle: Dishes that use it (share of what recipes say)
leaks.transferBreakdown: Two branches that mirror each other
leaks.purchasesInPeriod: Purchases of this ingredient in the period

costs.title: Costs
costs.subtitle: What your restaurant spends outside food, so the daily profit estimate is real.
costs.foodCostBody: Until your recipes are set up, the daily profit estimate assumes food costs this share of sales. It is always shown as an assumption.
costs.label: Note
costs.salaryBody: Monthly salary and allowances per person. Used for the daily labour cost.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.subtitle: What goes into each dish, so every plate has a cost.
recipes.coverage: {with} of {total} menu items have a recipe.
recipes.editRecipe: Change this recipe (saves a new version)
recipes.recipeHint: Quantity as bought, in the ingredient's unit. Yield is the usable share after trimming or cooking (100 if none is lost).
recipes.approved: Approved. The recipe is now active.
recipes.priceHint: Per kg, litre or piece. Leave empty if you don't know yet.
recipes.draftBody: Paste your menu or add a photo. You get draft recipes to correct; nothing is used until the owner approves it.
recipes.aiNotConfigured: AI drafting needs an Anthropic API key on the server. Until then, write recipes by hand in the Recipes tab.
recipes.menuPhoto: Or a photo of the menu

menuProfit.title: Menu profit
menuProfit.subtitle: Which dishes make money, which lose it, and what a price or portion change would do.
menuProfit.coverageHint: Food cost % is only for items with a recipe.

star.name: Stars
star.advice: Popular and profitable. Keep quality and visibility high.

plowhorse.name: Plowhorses
plowhorse.advice: Popular but thin. Nudge the price or trim the cost.

puzzle.name: Puzzles
puzzle.advice: Profitable but rarely ordered. Promote them.

dog.name: Dogs
dog.advice: Rarely ordered and thin. Rework or remove.

menuProfit.simBody: Try a new menu price or portion size and see the margin, at the last 28 days' sales.
menuProfit.simError: This item needs a costed recipe first.
menuProfit.simImpact: At the last 28 days' {qty} sold, that is {change} of margin.
menuProfit.simAssumption: A projection: it assumes the same number sold, which a price change may not keep.

assistant.help: I can answer questions like "How many mutton kacchi did we sell today?", "Sales this week?" or "Top items this month?". Ask me in Bangla, Banglish or English.
assistant.notPermitted: You don't have access to that figure. Cost and profit numbers are for the owner and accountant.
assistant.notFound: I couldn't find that item or branch. Check the name and ask again.
assistant.noData: I don't have that data yet.
assistant.cannotVerify: I couldn't give you an answer I can back with your data. Try asking about a specific item or period.
assistant.capNote: Today's AI allowance is used up, so this is the short answer.
assistant.stockFine: Nothing is running low right now.

explain.usage: {branch}, {from} to {to}: recipes called for {theoretical} of {ingredient}, the kitchen used {actual}, and {waste} was logged as waste. {unexplained} ({rate}) is unexplained, where other branches lose {baseline}. Beyond that, it is worth {impact}.
explain.posExceptions: There {count, plural, one {is # POS exception} other {are # POS exceptions}} at this branch in the same period; look at them together.
explain.usageActions: Check portions of those dishes, make sure all waste is logged, and keep the store locked.
explain.transfer: {ingredient}, {from} to {to}: {branch} used {over} more than its recipes explain, while {toBranch} used {under} less. About {qty} seems to have moved from {branch} to {toBranch} without a transfer, worth {impact}. Record transfers whenever goods move.
explain.price: {branch} paid more than the market for {ingredient} on {days} day(s) between {from} and {to} — {overpay} over, {impact} in total. Compare suppliers and ask for written receipts.
explain.unconfirmed: {fromBranch} sent goods to {branch} on {date} and nobody has confirmed receiving them (worth {impact}). Confirm it on the Stock page.
explain.generic: {type} at {branch}, {from} to {to}: {impact}. Open Leaks to see the evidence.

assistantPage.title: Assistant
assistantPage.subtitle: Ask about your sales and leaks in Bangla, Banglish or English. Every number comes from your data.
assistantPage.rulesBody: Your goals and rules. The assistant follows them in every answer.
assistantPage.routerMode: AI is not switched on yet: I answer common questions (item counts, sales, top items) directly from your data.
assistantPage.emptyTitle: Ask me anything about your restaurant
assistantPage.emptyBody: For example: how many mutton kacchi did we sell in the last 2 hours?
assistantPage.examples: Try: ajke koto ta kacchi bikri hoyeche?

briefs.morningSales: Yesterday: net sales {net} from {orders} orders (same day last week: {lastWeek}).
briefs.breakeven: To cover today's costs you need {amount} in sales.
briefs.weeklySales: Last 7 days: net sales {net} from {orders} orders (the 7 days before: {previous}).
briefs.leaks: {count} new leaks to look at; the biggest is {top}. Open Xedine → Leaks.
briefs.habits: {branch}: {score}/100 on yesterday's habits (bazar, waste log, cash close, count).
briefs.lowStock: {n} {count, plural, one {ingredient is} other {ingredients are}} running low — check Stock.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: What should be on the shelf, how long it lasts, and where the gaps are.
stock.noBranch: You have no branch to look after yet.
stock.countSubmitted: Count submitted. Levels now start from what you counted.
stock.countDue: Today is count day. The weekly count takes ten minutes and keeps every number honest.
stock.countBody: Count what is on the shelf at close. The guided count asks only for the costliest items.
stock.levelsRed: {count, plural, one {# ingredient is} other {# ingredients are}} running low.
stock.levelsBody: From your last count, plus purchases and transfers, minus what the sales used and waste.
stock.noStockBody: Do a first count, and levels will follow from sales and purchases.
stock.levelsHint: A negative level means more was used than the records explain — count it to find out.
stock.needTwoCountsBody: The gap between what was used and what recipes say appears after your second count.
stock.varianceBody: Actually used = counted before + bought + transfers − counted now. The gap is what was used beyond the recipes and the logged waste. Under 2% is healthy, 2–5% worth watching, over 5% a problem.
stock.varianceHint: A gap in one branch mirrored by the opposite gap in another often means goods moved without a transfer.
stock.wasteUnitHint: For a dish, the quantity is portions and the unit is ignored.
stock.noWaste: No waste logged in this period.
stock.receiveHint: Leave a line blank if all of it arrived. A different amount marks the transfer disputed.
stock.sendHint: The other branch confirms what arrives; until then it shows as on the way.
stock.sent: Sent. The other branch will confirm.
stock.blindHint: Count what you see — the sheet does not show what the system expects, on purpose.
stock.submitHint: Submitting is final. Save to come back later.
stock.bridgeTitle: Why food cost differs from the recipes
stock.bridgeBody: What the recipes say the food should have cost, and each reason the real cost was different, in taka. The parts always add up.

bridge.tfc: Recipes say food should have cost
bridge.price: Prices paid above the period’s standard

stock.bridgeFoot: Counts are trusted to about ±{band}. Food cost was {pct} of sales in this period.
stock.bridgeUncosted: {count, plural, one {# ingredient has} other {# ingredients have}} no price yet and are left out.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: The bazar, entered by form, by a photo of the chit, or by voice.
purchases.linesHint: One row per item; the total paid for that row. The unit cost updates from what you paid.
purchases.aiBody: Snap the bazar chit or receipt, or say what was bought. You check the draft before anything is saved.
purchases.aiNotConfigured: AI is not set up yet (the owner needs to add an API key). You can still enter purchases by form.
purchases.photo: Photo of the chit or receipt
purchases.voiceUnsupported: Voice needs Chrome on Android or a desktop browser that supports it — typing works everywhere.
purchases.listening: Listening… speak item, quantity and price.
purchases.toCheck: {count, plural, one {# line to check} other {# lines to check}}
purchases.flaggedHint: Highlighted fields were unclear or did not match an ingredient — check them before confirming.
purchases.marketBody: Paste reference prices (for example the TCB market list) so Price Watch can compare a branch that buys alone. One line each: ingredient, taka, per (kg / litre / piece / dozen), date, source.
purchases.marketImported: Prices imported. Rows that did not match an ingredient were skipped.
